analysis_notes.environment: start inclusive, stop exclusive; all times use Time t (s)

a2_charge.model: U=asymptote+amplitude*exp(-(t-t0)/tau); profile OLS; free asymptote/amplitude; golden-section tau

a2_discharge.model: U=asymptote+amplitude*exp(-(t-t0)/tau); profile OLS; free asymptote/amplitude; golden-section tau

a2_charge_early.model: U=asymptote+amplitude*exp(-(t-t0)/tau); profile OLS; free asymptote/amplitude; golden-section tau

a2_discharge_early.model: U=asymptote+amplitude*exp(-(t-t0)/tau); profile OLS; free asymptote/amplitude; golden-section tau

greenhouse.window_rule: start inclusive, end exclusive; minute timestamps converted then rounded to 6 decimal seconds
greenhouse.fit_model: T(t)=baseline+A*(1-exp(-(t-60)/tau)); baseline fixed to mean on [0,60), linear amplitude profiled out and tau minimized on [20,1000] s

pt-star.window_rule: start inclusive, end exclusive; timestamps rounded to 6 decimal seconds after conversion
pt-star.conditional_model_note: V1/V0=p0/p1 requires a closed ideal gas at unchanged gas temperature; chamber volume and gas temperature are not CSV observables.

tidal-locking.window_rule: start inclusive, end exclusive, retain independent channel time grids
